notes: 19 paragraph-level historical claim references with direct URLs, source passage locators, access scopes and limitations. The displaced-person figures reported by USHMM have specific periods and administrative categories. The German transfers discussion analyzes the Potsdam text as an official policy document and does not assert it was implemented humanely. Japanese repatriation estimates come from abstracts or excerpts by Jonathan Bull and Lori Watt. Partition and Korea are introduced but require region-specific testimony for detailed life stories. No first-person individual refugee account is invented. No duration target.
description: Examines displaced persons, family tracing, population transfers, repatriation after empire, Partition and the practical meaning of reconstruction.
